title: Converting Unused Common Spaces in Office Buildings to Public Family Rooms
what_it_is: Converting Unused Common Spaces in Office Buildings to Public Family Rooms

sections.label: Family rooms and lactation facilities
sections.summary: Grants from BCA and MOM offset costs of family-friendly features, and URA and BCA will review measures encouraging lactation facilities and diaper changing areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for National Development (a) whether the Government can help existing office building owners which have used up the permissible gross floor area to look into unused common spaces to install public family rooms; and (b) how it can further encourage the provision of lactation facilities in new office buildings.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: There are also financial grants from BCA and the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) to offset the construction cost of such spaces.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Specifically, BCA's Accessibility Fund covers up to 40% of construction costs of family-friendly features, such as lactation rooms and accessible family washrooms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Specifically for developing lactation facilities, building owners and developers can also tap on MOM's WorkPro Work-Life Grant which covers half of the costs, up to a cap of $20,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The Urban Redevelopment Authority and BCA will continue to review and enhance the measures to encourage both workplaces and buildings frequented by families to provide more family-friendly spaces, including lactation facilities and diaper changing areas.

sections.label: Low take-up of grants
sections.summary: The take-up rate is low and grants and gross floor area incentive schemes are being reviewed to encourage building owners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The take-up rate is admittedly quite low, and we are continuing to review not just the grants but also the gross floor area incentive schemes to see what else we can do, to encourage building owners to put in place these measures.
